preconditions.description: The number of silos is between 2 and 2000, inclusive.
The number of scout groups is between 1 and n - 1, inclusive.
The number of droids that patrol the passages is between -1 and 10^9, inclusive.
No passages connect a silo with itself.

postconditions.description: The output is the average danger of the scouting operation, rounded down to an integer.
